Rule definitions

  • 1h reference: Only 1-hour zones are eligible.
  • 1h · no BOS: Only 1-hour zones without formation BOS.
  • 1h · RVOL 0.75–1.25: Formation RVOL must be at least 0.75 and below 1.25.
  • 1h · impulse/prior volume <0.75: Impulse-candle volume must be below 75% of the preceding source candle.
  • 1h · first SND test: A zone is eligible only before its first selected SND test.
  • 1h · first physical touch: A zone is eligible only during its first continuous physical overlap episode.
  • 1h · width ≤0.5 ATR: Zone width must be no greater than half the formation ATR.
  • 1h · opposing room ≥2R/open: Nearest active opposing zone must be at least two structural R away, or absent.
